prompt:
Photograph of a Dutch fluyt of the 1650s, a long narrow cargo ship whose
sides curve sharply inward above the waterline, a rounded stern topped
by a tall, narrow, flat transom with a small carved panel, almost no
raised bow deck, three tall masts with square sails on the fore and
main, a lateen mizzen and a spritsail, a dark varnished hull with green
and ochre trim and few gun ports, under sail at sea, seen from low over
the water, her bow to the left and a little towards us, a blue sea with
white crests and the open sea running to the horizon all round her and a
sky of soft even blue with a few white clouds, a natural photograph with
no frame, no border and no circle. Historical reenactment photography,
sharp focus, realistic. The whole ship is built of planked wood: no
tower, nothing of stone.
